commit.message:
Update documentation and CSV to specify minimum OCP and K8s version

With the introduction of Ingress networking.k8s.io/v1 the minimum
Kubernetes version for apicast-operator is K8s 1.19 because that
object APIVersion was introduced in that version, and the minimum
OCP versions is OCP 4.6 because it is the first one to make use of
K8s 1.19.

Change Ingress object to use networking.k8s.io/v1 APIversion

The motivation of this change is due to K8s 1.22 removes Ingress in
extensions/v1beta.

Update K8s libraries to v0.19.14

This involves k8s.io/api, k8s.io/apimachinery,
k8s.io/client-go, sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime.
The motivation of this change is to allow the usage
of the Ingress K8s object in the 'k8s.io/api/networking/v1'
which is introduced in v0.19.x libraries.
It also includes permissions to manage leases (leases.coordination.k8s.io)
which is required after the update of the libraries.
Use 'latest' APIcast image tag instead of 'nightly'
Rename apicast image envvar to RELATED_IMAGE_APICAST to support digest pinning
move cr samples to doc/cr_samples
Improve APIcast CRD fields descriptions

Use quay.io/3scale/apicast-operator:master image

'nightly' tag does not exist in the case of apicast-operator
Regenerate manifests and bundle with operator-sdk v1.2.0
Add permissions to manage apicasts finalizers
Update image in bundle CSV to quay.io/3scale/apicast-operator:nightly
Migrate additional CSV fields and regenerate OLM bundle CSV
